summary: The note describes the ZEC Bras-Coupé-Désert, a controlled harvesting zone (zone d'exploitation contrôlée) in Quebec, Canada. It is located in the unorganized territory of Lac-Pythonga within La Vallée-de-la-Gatineau Regional County Municipality in the Outaouais administrative region. The note is a brief definitional entry with no further detail.
one_line: A controlled harvesting zone (ZEC) in the unorganized territory of Lac-Pythonga, Outaouais, Quebec, Canada.

The ZEC Bras-Coupé-Désert is located in La Vallée-de-la-Gatineau Regional County Municipality.
The ZEC Bras-Coupé-Désert is in the administrative region of Outaouais.
The ZEC Bras-Coupé-Désert is in Quebec, Canada.
